name: Ellsworth Mountains (Antarctica)
sources: Antarctic Logistics & Expeditions (ALE) Union Glacier and Vinson camp weather observations
Turner, J. et al. (2004) The SCAR READER project: toward a high-quality database of mean Antarctic meteorological observations. Journal of Climate 17
Hersbach, H. et al. (2020) The ERA5 global reanalysis. QJRMS 146:1999-2049 (monthly climatology 1991-2020, 300 hPa winds)
notes: Only Dec-Jan is climbed (24 h daylight). Surface inversions are common, so the free-air lapse rate is an approximation; storms bring wind chill below -50 °C.
